sections.heading: Description of the Service
sections.html:
OpenBitcoin.com is an independently operated block explorer and set of tools for the Bitcoin network. Blockchain data shown on the site is read from our own Bitcoin full node. The bitcoin price shown is calculated as a median of three exchanges. Details of how figures are produced are documented on the sources page.

The service is informational only. It has no user accounts. It does not hold, transmit, or have access to funds, and it does not provide custody, brokerage, exchange, or wallet services.

Some tools are designed to run entirely in your browser. If interactive features are added in the future, they may carry additional terms presented at the time of use.

Data on the service may be delayed, estimated, or inaccurate. Prices are derived figures, fee estimates are approximations, and recently broadcast transactions and blocks can be reorganized or replaced. Verify any information independently, for example against your own node, before relying on it or acting on it.

sections.html:
The service depends on the internet, on the Bitcoin network, and on supporting infrastructure. You accept the risks inherent in internet-based services and public blockchain data, including outages, delays, data errors, and chain reorganizations.

These tools are designed so that key material is processed locally in your browser and is not transmitted to our servers. Because of this, you are solely responsible for generating, storing, and safeguarding your keys and seeds, and for independently verifying any output of these tools before using it with real funds.
